data.name: Khabeer
data.gender_notes: Khabeer is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: In Islamic history, Prophet Khidr, also known as Khabeer, was a wise and righteous servant of Allah. He was given the power to live for centuries, and he used it to help people and guide them towards the right path. The name Khabeer means 'the gatherer' or 'the one who is aware'. It symbolizes the importance of knowledge, wisdom, and righteousness.
data.etymology: Khabeer belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “The Gatherer or Aware.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Khabeer total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.
